backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user authentication, invoice storage, Stripe integration, usage tracking with fingerprint-based limits, event logging, and admin-only access controls for a VAT invoice management system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features for manual input fields (supplier legal name, address, VAT number, invoice number, invoice date) with required validation that prevents PDF download if empty.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components covering routing, authentication, VAT calculation flow, invoice generation, usage limits, Stripe integration, and UI components.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documents the deployment slug "glotaxa" with platform validation constraints (5-50 chars, alphanumeric plus hyphens) enforced at build time.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags, title "Glotaxa", and script reference to the React application mounted at #root.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Production deployment checklist for Version 39 covering build preparation, deployment steps, post-deployment verification including console markers, metadata checks, VAT logic validation, and rollback procedures.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Production smoke test runbook verifying console markers, route accessibility, authentication flows, Stripe checkout integration, and security checks for the deployed Version 39 application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application entry point that sets up TanStack Router with routes for landing, calculator, invoices, upgrade, and payment pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and including a Toaster component.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, manages authentication state, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Multi-field form component for entering invoice details including supplier/customer information, line items with VAT categories, and displays compliance checklist and risk check panels. Validates mandatory fields and performs risk checks before allowing progression to next step.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays a checklist card showing which mandatory invoice fields are present or missing, with visual indicators (checkmarks/X icons) and an alert for missing required fields.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Invoice preview component that renders HTML invoice, validates mandatory fields, performs risk checks, and handles saving/downloading invoices with quota enforcement and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Dialog component that displays deterministic risk analysis results for invoice acceptance by Finanzamt, showing critical issues and warnings with disclaimer about not being legal advice.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with sticky header containing brand logo, navigation tabs (Calculator, Invoices, Upgrade), login button, and handles app_opened analytics event logging.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Admin-only component for configuring Stripe secret key and allowed countries; displays a warning card when Stripe is not yet configured and the user is an admin.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Button component that creates a Stripe checkout session for a given plan and redirects the user to the Stripe payment page; logs analytics events.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Modal dialog that appears when free plan invoice limit is reached, prompting the user to upgrade with a CTA button that navigates to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Modal displaying Starter and Pro plan options with pricing and features, allowing users to navigate to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Alert banner showing remaining invoice count for free plan users (e.g., '3 of 5 invoices remaining this month').
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Step component with tabs for EU and UK regions, displaying a grid of country buttons with flags and VAT rates for country selection.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Complex form step for entering transaction details including customer type (B2B/B2C), country, VAT ID, service/product category, net amount, and export status; calculates effective VAT rate and validates inputs.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays country-specific VAT information including standard, reduced, and zero rates with feature list; shows warning if country configuration is pending.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Displays a country selection grid for EU VAT calculation, showing flags, names, and standard rates, with a continue button that triggers onCountrySelect callback.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Renders VAT calculation explanations in two tabs (standard and simple), with region-specific logic for UK/Germany, PDF export button (Pro feature), and navigation controls.
Modal dialog that prompts free users to upgrade to Pro for VAT explanation features, logging upgrade CTA events and navigating to /upgrade.
Visual stepper component showing progress through multi-step flow with checkmarks for completed steps and connecting lines between steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Displays a muted alert banner with disclaimer text stating that VAT rates vary and the tool provides estimates only, not legal advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ProductCateg: Grid of selectable product category buttons with checkmarks, supporting both standard values and exempt identifiers for category selection.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Card component that validates B2B cross-border VAT reverse charge eligibility by checking VAT ID format and country match, displaying validation results with badges.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Form step collecting transaction details including customer type (B2C/B2B), VAT ID, product category, VAT category, and net amount with validation and navigation.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkSelectC: Initial step for UK VAT calculator showing UK VAT rates (20% standard, 5% reduced, 0% zero) and registration threshold information. Simple continue button to proceed.
frontend/src/components/vat/uk/UkTransac: Form component for collecting UK transaction details including transaction type, customer type, VAT category, net amount, and optional VAT ID. Includes misuse warning checks and validation.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatCategoryI: Grid of selectable VAT category buttons (standard, reduced, exempt) with visual selection state and checkmarks.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Displays VAT calculation results with formatted amounts, classification badges, and educational notes for different VAT scenarios (reverse charge, intra-EU supply, exports, etc.). Provides navigation buttons to proceed or go back.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Centralized application metadata defining app name ('Glotaxa'), suggested deployment slug, and description. Includes deployment slug validation function with regex constraints.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: React Query hook that fetches user's account plan (free/starter/pro) and monthly invoice usage from the backend actor. Depends on authenticated identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Core hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Manages anonymous user usage tracking with a 5-invoice free limit using daily fingerprints. Provides usage count, remaining quota, and increment mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook for creating Stripe checkout sessions via backend actor. Validates returned Stripe URLs and constructs success/cancel redirect URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Generates and manages daily browser fingerprints combined with IP-based country detection for anonymous user tracking. Returns fingerprint, country, and availability status.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Convenience hook for logging analytics events with automatic fingerprint and country enrichment. Wraps the core logEvent function with actor and fingerprint context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status. Configures AuthClient with derivation origin and idle options.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceNumberUniqu: Hook for checking if an invoice number already exists in the backend. Returns false on errors to avoid blocking invoice creation.
Provides React Query hooks for invoice operations including listing invoices, downloading individual PDFs, bulk ZIP downloads by selection or month, and exporting to CSV/Excel formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Manages invoice quota enforcement for free plan (5 invoices/month limit) and provides a mutation hook for saving invoices with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Returns boolean flags indicating the user's active subscription plan (free, starter, pro) and derived access levels.
Detects and returns the browser's preferred language code, normalized to two-letter format, with an isEnglish convenience flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching the current user profile and checking if Stripe payment integration is configured.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color palette for light/dark themes, plus global z-index fixes for Radix UI dropdown/select components to prevent clipping.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Defines immutable core analytics event names as constants (app_opened, vat_calculated, payment_success, etc.) for consistent tracking.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Detects user country from IP address using ipapi.co public API, returning country code and IP for analytics purposes.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Logs analytics events to the backend actor with automatic device type detection, page tracking, and graceful error handling.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Generates GDPR-safe daily fingerprints by hashing IP + user agent + date using SHA-256, with session caching to avoid recomputation.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Constructs complete HTML invoice documents from invoice data and VAT calculation results, including line items, VAT breakdown, totals, and optional German-to-English translation.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/currency.ts: Provides currency utilities including country-to-currency mapping via VAT table, currency formatting with Intl API, and local currency detection from browser locale.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/deriveInvoiceVa: Derives structured VAT outcome (rate, amount, label, currency) from VAT calculation results for invoice persistence, with cross-border treatment prioritization.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Auto-generates country-specific legal VAT text for invoices based on scenario and cross-border treatment, using wording modules for compliance.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getInvoiceWordi: Returns country-specific legal wording for VAT scenarios (Reverse Charge, Exempt, Zero Rated, Reduced VAT, Standard VAT) with localized text for DE, FR, IT, and GB.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceLineItem: Defines invoice line item data structures and provides calculation functions for line item totals, invoice aggregates, VAT rate grouping, and multi-rate detection.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/invoiceVatCateg: Provides VAT category note generation for reduced rates, special scenarios (zero-rate, reverse-charge, exempt), and aggregates all required notes for an invoice.
Maps country codes to localized reverse charge and exempt wording for multiple EU countries with fallback to generic EU VAT Directive text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Performs comprehensive invoice risk checks including mandatory field validation, legal VAT text requirements, reverse charge proof, and scenario-specific compliance warnings.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates invoice compliance with blocking errors and warnings for supplier/customer information, VAT number formats, and country support (truncated file).
Checks presence of mandatory invoice fields (supplier info, invoice number/date, line items, totals) and scenario-specific requirements like legal VAT text (truncated file).
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production build version marker (v39) to the console in production mode for deployment verification purposes.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic offline German-to-English translation using a fixed dictionary for invoice fields, preserving capitalization and punctuation, with a heuristic to detect German text.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUkVat.ts: Calculates UK VAT for different transaction types (goods export, service to EU business, exempt, international sale, domestic) returning net/VAT/gross amounts in cents with scenario labels and messages.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateUnifiedVat: Smart VAT engine that determines cross-border VAT treatment, maps treatment to VAT rates, calculates amounts, and returns results with legal notes and invoice wording for both domestic and international transactions.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VATCalculationInput and VATCalculationResult types and provides calculateEUVAT and calculateGermanyVAT functions handling reverse charge, exempt treatment, and standard/reduced rate calculations.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVatAmounts: Helper function that calculates VAT amount and total from net amount and rate using the formula: vatAmount = netAmount * rate / 100; total = netAmount + vatAmount.
frontend/src/lib/vat/categoryEligibility: Defines exempt, UK zero, UK reduced, and EU reduced category lists with eligibility check functions using normalized identifier matching to support both snake_case and kebab-case.
frontend/src/lib/vat/deriveVatRatePercen: Derives the VAT rate percentage for backend from UI state (country, VAT category, treatment, reverse charge) handling cross-border, exempt, reduced, and standard scenarios.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineCrossBorde: Cross-border VAT treatment engine that determines treatment type (domestic, intra-EU supply, export, reverse charge) based on seller/buyer countries, B2B/B2C status, and supply type, with functions to map treatment to rates and invoice wording.
frontend/src/lib/vat/determineVatRate.ts: VAT rate decision engine implementing priority flow: reverse charge, export, exempt, UK zero, reduced (with eligibility checks and auto-fallback), and standard rate as default.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Defines EU country VAT configuration including country codes, flags, standard/reduced rates, invoice labels, and reverse charge text for 11 countries (DE, FR, NL, PL, SE, IT, BE, AT, HU, ES, GB). Exports helper function to retrieve country config with UK→GB normalization.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainUkVat.ts: Generates UK-specific VAT explanations for different scenarios (domestic standard/reduced/zero, export zero-rated, reverse charge, exempt) with detailed descriptions of what each scenario means and how it differs from similar concepts.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Provides detailed VAT explanations for German VAT scenarios including Kleinunternehmer exemption, reverse charge, VAT exemption, digital B2C EU sales, intra-EU supply, and reduced/standard B2C rates with legal references and practical implications.
Simplifies VAT explanations into plain language for non-experts, covering the same German VAT scenarios as explainVat.ts but using everyday analogies and simple terms suitable for a 12-year-old audience.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Tracks historical German VAT rates including the COVID-19 temporary reduction (16%/5% from July-Dec 2020) and provides functions to retrieve correct VAT rates for specific dates and detect rate differences between invoice and current dates.
frontend/src/lib/vat/identifierNormaliza: Provides utility functions to normalize category identifiers (lowercase, trim, convert underscores to hyphens) and compare identifiers consistently regardless of format (snake_case vs kebab-case).
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Barrel export file that re-exports all VAT-related modules and selectively exports specific items from determineCrossBorderVAT to avoid type conflicts.
frontend/src/lib/vat/isZeroVatResult.ts: Helper function to identify when a VAT calculation result indicates a zero-VAT scenario (UK export zero-rated or explicit 0% rate), used by invoice editors to lock VAT rate to 0%.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Checks if One-Stop-Shop (OSS) registration is relevant for a transaction by detecting digital/SaaS services sold B2C cross-border within the EU and provides explanatory reasons.
frontend/src/lib/vat/productCategoryOpti: Defines product category dropdown options for VAT engine including basic food, books, medical, transport, hotel, financial services, insurance, education, and UK-specific domestic fuel, with country-based filtering.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Contains system prompt and screen-by-screen prompts for a German VAT calculation flow covering country selection, transaction details, calculation logic, invoice generation, explanations, usage limits, and upgrade pricing.
Defines product categories eligible for reduced VAT rates per country (EU common categories and UK-specific 5%/0% categories), with functions to check eligibility and retrieve the appropriate reduced rate.
frontend/src/lib/vat/region.ts: Provides region detection and normalization utilities for VAT calculations, mapping country codes to regions (EU, UK, USA, APAC) and checking region support status.
frontend/src/lib/vat/selectedSellerCount: Reads and validates the seller country from URL query parameters, normalizing country codes (UK→GB) and validating against supported countries in VAT_TABLE.
frontend/src/lib/vat/toBackendVatCalcula: Converts frontend VAT calculation form input to backend VatCalculation payload format, normalizing country codes, mapping service categories, and determining VAT rates using the decision engine.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukMisuseWarnings.ts: Checks for UK VAT misuse patterns (e.g., reduced rate for consulting, zero rate for software) and returns appropriate warning messages.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ukTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript types for UK-specific VAT calculations including transaction types, customer types, VAT categories, and result structures.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates reverse charge eligibility for B2B cross-border transactions by checking VAT ID format and verifying the VAT ID country prefix matches the customer country.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories and computes country-specific VAT rates based on category eligibility rules for DE, FR, IT, SE, BE, ES, and GB, falling back to standard rates for other countries.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatConfig.ts: Defines standard and reduced VAT rates for all supported countries (DE, FR, NL, PL, SE, IT, BE, AT, HU, ES, GB) in a simple configuration object.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatResultBuilder.ts: Provides a utility function to build canonical VAT result objects containing rate, VAT amount, total, and label from net amount and rate inputs.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatTable.ts: Central VAT configuration table mapping country codes to standard/reduced rates, currency, and VAT prefix, with lookup utilities supporting both 2-letter codes and legacy country names.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Multi-step VAT calculator flow page managing country selection, transaction details, VAT calculation results, AI explanation, invoice details input, and invoice preview with navigation between steps.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Invoice management page displaying list of invoices with features for single/batch PDF downloads, monthly ZIP exports, CSV/Excel exports, and plan-gated premium features with upgrade prompts.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing VAT calculator features with quick country selection for EU and UK regions, directing users to the calculator flow.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page displaying error message with options to retry payment or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success confirmation page that logs analytics event, invalidates plan cache, and provides navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Subscription upgrade page displaying Free/Starter/Pro plan tiers with Stripe checkout integration, authentication checks, and admin setup for unconfigured Stripe.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility function to trigger browser downloads for text (CSV) or binary (PDF/ZIP/Excel) content by creating blob URLs and programmatically clicking download links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and methods to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for a React app with path aliases, environment variable injection for canister IDs, proxy setup for local API calls, and optimizations for Internet Computer development.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing an invoice management application with 8 implemented features for required field validation (supplier info, invoice details, line items, totals) and 4 pending feature requests related to compliance validation before PDF generation.
